cands.bio: Republican attorney and farmer from Sutter County. Served on the Sutter County Board of Supervisors for six years, then in the California State Assembly (District 3) from 2014 to 2026, including as Minority Leader from 2022 to 2025. Won the 2026 special election for CA-1 and took office in June 2026.

endorsements.text: Donald Trump endorsed Gallagher in the 2026 regular and special elections.
The Republican Party of California endorsed him in the 2026 special election.
Reform California listed him as a 2026 endorsement.

cands.gaps: We found no documented stance by Gallagher on data centers, or on limiting or expanding development. We found no record of him acting on homestead property taxes, limits on investor or foreign land buyers, gun policy, school choice or teacher pay. His campaign says he wants lower taxes, but that is not specific to home property taxes. The pages we read did not list his state legislative votes or the bills he sponsored. We found no controversies, foreign ties or notable endorsements beyond those listed. Details of his childhood beyond attending local schools were not available.

cands.bio: Democrat and California state senator for District 2 since 2014. Served as Senate majority leader (2022–24) and Senate president pro tempore (2024–25). Earlier a Healdsburg school board member, city councilmember and mayor, and Sonoma County supervisor. Won the U.S. House District 1 general election in November 2026.

endorsements.text: For the June 2026 special election, Ballotpedia lists endorsements from the Democratic Party of California, California Federation of Labor Unions, California Teachers Association, IUOE Local 3, National Union of Healthcare Workers, California Environmental Voters, California Young Democrats and Equality California.

cands.gaps: We found no documented positions on data centers or on development, apart from his campaign site's general claim about protecting open space. We found nothing on homestead property taxes, limits on investor or foreign land buying, H-1B or immigration enforcement, police pay and pensions, gun laws, or school vouchers and teacher pay. His campaign site describes actions but does not list specific bills for most of these. He did not complete Ballotpedia's 2026 candidate survey. No controversies or foreign ties appeared in the pages we could read.
